name: myksp
description: myKSP: a modern space-program front end for a realism KSP install

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p services/bridge && tsc -p apps/ops-center
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run bridge
scripts.release: npm run build && esbuild services/bridge/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=release/bridge.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && rm -rf release/ops-center && cp -r apps/ops-center/dist release/ops-center
